scientific_integrity: Proof uses published primality and Cohen-Macaulayness plus original geometric incidence and codimension arguments. Finite checker is auxiliary. No independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Normality is established for complex multiprojective maximal-minor loci with at least two positive-dimensional Segre factors and n>=M+1, not for the affine multicone or arbitrary non-Segre multiview models. The singular locus is bounded, not classified exactly; historical uniqueness is provisional.
title: Normality and codimension-two rank degeneration of Segre-determinantal loci
